678-2921-4022.notablePrerequisites: A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn
678-2921-4022.description:
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying its mana cost.
When Hidden Herbalists enters, it triggers, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Hidden Herbalists.
When Hidden Herbalists dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Hidden Herbalists from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat.

539-4687-5296.notablePrerequisites: Workhorse has at least four counters on it.
539-4687-5296.description:
Activate Ashaya by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Workhorse, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1957-4050-6273--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3899-5870.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3899-5870.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1306-4574-4659-4750-6842.notablePrerequisites: There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
1306-4574-4659-4750-6842.description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Flux Channeler triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts you control.
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mana Crypt, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mana Crypt from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Mana Crypt.
Repeat.

801-3967-5220-7855.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Impulsive Pilferer onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling Impulsive Pilferer from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from exile by paying {R}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1878-2713-3454-4539-7654.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has six or more cards in hand.
1878-2713-3454-4539-7654.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Jeska's Will and casting it without paying its mana cost, adding at least six {R}.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Unexpected Windfall and casting it without paying its mana cost and discarding a card.
Resolve Unexpected Windfall, causing you to draw two cards and create two Treasures.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Sundering Archaic twice by paying {4}, putting Unexpected Windfall and Jeska's Will from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat.

891-4050-5617.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

3490-6006-7075-7295.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6006-7075-7295.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2060-2713-5140-7267.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2713-5140-7267.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2366-3499-4974-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3499-4974-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

804-4499-7009.manaNeeded: {3} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
804-4499-7009.description:
Activate Sakashima the Impostor using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Sakashima the Impostor. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

1486-1753-5396-7014.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing North Pole Patrol to become a Dwarf until end of turn.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat from step 2.
1486-1753-5396-7014.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

620-3532-5060-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
620-3532-5060-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
620-3532-5060-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

2173-5010-5686-5708.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

2556-3647-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
2556-3647-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Peregrine Drake
When Mnemonic Wall and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
2556-3647-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

2173-2292-5220-6538.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

856-5270-5670.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control a Food token.
856-5270-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Samwise trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food token.
Repeat.

222-527-5256-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5256-6791.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

862-2538-3676-6193.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, Soul of the Harvest triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Soul of the Harvest trigger, causing you to return Crimson Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1496-2034-4417-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher does not have a counter on it.
1496-2034-4417-5944.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher, adding {C}{C}.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
When Unstoppable Slasher enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Unstoppable Slasher's toughness.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {2} and 2 life, removing both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher and giving Hex Parasite +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

891-2034-2523-5515.easyPrerequisites: On Serra's Wings attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2034-2523-5515.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant, adding {C}{C}.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to On Serra's Wings, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning On Serra's Wings from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Repeat.

614-1987-3120.notablePrerequisites:
Mindsplice Apparatus has at least two oil counters on it.
You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
614-1987-3120.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking Nucklavee and the mana-producing permanent.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

573-1462-2929.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, it and Composer of Spring trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2011-4050-4689.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
You have at least four experience counters.
2011-4050-4689.description:
Declare Otharri as an attacker.
Otharri triggers, causing you to get an experience counter and create at least five 2/2 Rebel creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Rebels, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

222-647-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
Slimefoot and Squee does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
222-647-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slimefoot and Squee as attackers.
Slimefoot and Squee triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Saproling token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2105-2857-4068-5256.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Combat Celebrant.
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Combat Celebrant dies, triggering Adarkar Valkyrie, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Combat Celebrant's power.
Repeat.

1371-2751-3367.description:
Cast Paradigm Shift by paying {1}{U}, triggering Hive Mind.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Hive Mind's trigger.
Resolve the Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Paradigm Shift twice.
Resolve each Paradigm Shift copy, exiling your opponent' libraries.
Resolve the original Paradigm Shift, exiling your library and putting your graveyard into your library.

337-776-1329-1596.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Embraal Gear-Smasher do not have summoning sickness.
337-776-1329-1596.description:
Tap Embraal Gear-Smasher, sacrificing Engineered Explosives to deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Tap Emry, targeting Engineered Explosives.
Cast Engineered Explosives.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

924-1116-3240-4289.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token creature with haste.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate the Graveborn token using the ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing the Graveborn token.
Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Nether Traitor using the ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

600-1180-2369.notablePrerequisites: Nicol Bolas has at least four loyalty counters on it.
600-1180-2369.description:
Activate Nicol Bolas using Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player this turn.
Activate Nicol Bolas using Jace's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating two copies of Nicol Bolas.
Repeat using a Nicol Bolas token instead.
